seen.where: openapi.bnf.fr IIIF images of Gallica ark btv1b52521512h (BnF fr. 20140, 'Recueil de pieces relatives a la Suede et au Danemark (1557-1706)'), views 1-68 as thumbnails, views 31 and 36 full size, 15 Nov 2026. The shelfmark is confirmed by the '20.140' label on the cover (view 2), and the Gallica title (SRU, Chrome tab, 15 Nov 2026) matches Omont. Omont's f. 16 is right here: view 31 is stamped 16, headed 'Danemark', dated 10 Jan 1557 (old style) on the left margin, a plain letter, so views = folios + 15.
seen.extent: Full pages of symbol cipher on views 35-38 (ff. 20-23), 51-54 and 61-66 on the thumbnails, with partly ciphered pages beside them (views 47-48, 60); about 15 cipher pages in all, from the Danzay letters of 1557 onwards. View 36 (f. 21) read at full size: about 20 lines of Greek-like and numeral-like symbols run together, with plain French words and names interleaved ('pour le grand', 'par plus amplement', 'Andreas'), written in one 16th-century hand.
seen.cipher: Monoalphabetic-looking symbol cipher with plain-text words left in the line, and no interlinear, marginal or facing decipherment on the pages seen (a few pages carry short marginal notes, not opened). The volume's other items are printed treaties, the 'Estat present de la Suede' and 17th-century Swedish despatches in plain French.

2745.unvetted: Vetting pass 15 Nov 2026 (Omont NAF sweep): Viewed on Gallica (openapi IIIF views 3-9, 12, 40, 100, 200 of btv1b9063488m, 15 Nov 2026; shelfmark and title confirmed by SRU). Key copy at ff. 1-2 (views 4-5) is a partial 19th-century-looking list of numbers with syllables and names (Mazarin, l'abbe Fouquet, la Reine). The ciphered letters are plain French with number groups and carry a CONTEMPORARY PARTIAL INTERLINEAR DECIPHERMENT (views 8-9 and 40: names and syllables written over the numbers), most letters are plain autographs (views 12, 100, 200). Not promoted: the bar needs no decipherment on the leaf, so each ciphered letter must first be checked for interlinear text; DECODE R7894-R7897 (ff. 67, 279, 306, 350) already solved. Chéruel's Lettres de Mazarin / Fouquet studies not checked for these letters.
